verdict.rationale: Linear has an integration directory with many third-party apps, including GitHub, Slack, Figma, GitLab, Sentry, Datadog, Salesforce, Notion, Zendesk-style helpdesk, Fivetran, Airbyte, Attio, Cursor, Copilot and Devin. Third parties can submit agents to the directory, and admins can review and approve apps before installation. However, nothing in the evidence shows a catalog anywhere near 'thousands' of tools; the evidenced directory spans dozens of integrations. Missing for 10: evidence of a catalog at the scale of thousands of tools, independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience.
